description: This file defines a class CharCountBased within the FastRoute library, responsible for generating data structures based on character counts for routing purposes. It extends an abstract class RegexBasedAbstract and implements methods for processing route chunks with regex patterns.

classes.name: CharCountBased
classes.description: A class for generating route data based on character count, extending RegexBasedAbstract.

methods.name: getApproxChunkSize
methods.description: Returns an approximate size (30) for chunks of route data processing.

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Processes a map of regex to routes into a combined regex and route map, grouping routes based on suffixes.
